name: Honda - Marysville Motorcycle Plant (MMP) - Marysville OH

fieldNotes.siteIdentity: The Marysville Motorcycle Plant (Honda's original 1979 US plant) ceased motorcycle production in June 2009 and was converted to vehicle suspension sub-assembly. It is NOT a separable standalone facility — it occupies the eastern wing of the contiguous Marysville Auto Plant (MAP) building footprint and shares the MAP truck/trailer/rail infrastructure. Coordinates and geofences were placed on that eastern wing and its associated east-side truck yard. The roster's idx-1 (MAP) and idx-12 (MMP) reference the same physical complex.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The MAP/MMP complex is a fully guarded, fenced auto-manufacturing campus. Honda Parkway entrances are signalized and controlled; satellite shows checkpoint/booth structures at the truck-yard access. Classified true with medium confidence — no Street View coverage exists inside the secured property to confirm a specific barrier arm.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small booth-footprint structures visible at the truck-yard checkpoint on satellite, consistent with staffed guard booths standard at auto plants of this scale. Medium confidence (no on-the-ground SV inside the gate).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Extensive paved internal aprons and holding lanes between the gate and the dock banks / drop yard.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal approach roads easily hold queues of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple separate entrances around the complex perimeter (employee entrances on Honda Parkway, truck/rail access on the east) — distinct in and out points.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door banks with trailers backed in along multiple building faces of the eastern wing; 90+ doors estimated. Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Massive marked trailer drop yard on the east side holding hundreds of trailers without tractors.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated multi-row trailer-storage yard east of the building, clearly separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur runs along and into the east side of the complex serving the manufacturing operation.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The MMP wing is one part of the larger contiguous Marysville complex (MAP + MMP + adjacent support buildings) — a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Vast paved truck-yard width leaves ample room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Counted as 1 for the MMP wing itself, though it is physically joined to the larger MAP complex.
fieldNotes.multiStep: An auto-plant truck yard of this size plausibly has a gate plus a separate yard-control checkpoint, but a clear second checkpoint stage was not confirmed in imagery — left flagged.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — the complex sits in open farmland NW of Marysville, OH.
